'''Internal-combustion''' was a type of [[Engine/Legends|engine]] power source that drove archaic [[wheel]]ed [[autocar]]s.<ref name="RPG" /> Manufacturers of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines made the claim that their product had effectively rendered other engine types, such as internal-combustion, obsolete. However, internal-combustion engines were still in use on less-developed [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
